analysis_scope: Post-completion descriptive harmonization; not preregistered and not a hypothesis or equivalence test.
estimand: For each structured-method condition cell and paired seed, method mIoU minus the strongest of three controls in that seed.

rules.condition_cell: method x region/direction x architecture x budget; cells share data and models and are not independent samples
rules.mean_outcome: win/loss/tie from the sign of the mean of three paired-seed differences; exact zero is a tie
rules.three_seed_consistent_win: all three paired-seed differences are strictly positive
rules.universal_method: the same named method is a three-seed-consistent win in every one of its tested condition cells
rules.strongest_control: post-completion conservative attribution envelope, not a deployable baseline
